_meta.usage: plates since June 2016 (01 123 ABC, region code at the left with the flag and KG under it; motorcycles 01 123 AB): type the whole plate or only the two digits
_meta.note: One code per region: 01 Bishkek, 02 Osh city, 03 Batken, 04 Jalal-Abad, 05 Naryn, 06 Osh Region, 07 Talas, 08 Chüy, 09 Issyk-Kul. The code is where the vehicle was registered, not where the photo was taken. 10 (legalized formerly foreign-plated cars, since 2025) and 11 (temporary) are not regions and are left out.
_meta.miss_note: not a regional Kyrgyz plate: 10 (cars legalized in 2025, mostly right-hand drive with former Armenian or Russian plates) or 11 (temporary), a 1994–2016 plate (a letter, four digits and one or two letters; use `--kind plate-1994`), a yellow foreign-resident plate (01 1234 H, four digits and one letter), a red diplomatic or blue UN plate, or a plate of another country (Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan also use two-digit codes)
